Hero.title: The new era of <highlight>education</highlight>
Hero.subtitle: Learnify is a modern platform, designed to bring education in the modern era. With integrated AI that adapts to every learner.

palette.title: Your AI tutor, one shortcut away.
palette.text: Press ⌘K anywhere to ask a question, summarize a lesson, build a quiz or plan your week, without leaving what you're studying.
palette.placeholder: Ask a question or search lessons…

adaptive.title: Lessons that adapt to how you learn.
adaptive.text: Learnify notices where you struggle and reshapes your path: extra practice here, a shortcut there.

integrations.title: Works with the tools you already use.
integrations.text: Bring your classes, files and calendars into one place, so learning never starts from zero.
points: Sync with Google Classroom and Moodle
Share reports with teachers and parents

plans.title: Turn goals into study plans.
plans.text: Tell Learnify what you're aiming for and when. It builds a plan and adjusts it as you go.
points: Set an exam date or a target skill
Get a daily plan that fits your time
Reschedule in one click when life happens

speed.title: Not a heavy LMS. Made to be fast.
speed.text: Learnify opens instantly, works on any screen and keeps out of your way, so you spend time learning, not waiting.

privacy.title: Your learning data stays yours.
privacy.text: No ads and no selling your data. You decide what to share and with whom.

features.title: Private by default
features.text: Only you see your progress until you share it.

features.title: Encrypted
features.text: Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest.

features.title: Exportable
features.text: Download your notes and results anytime.

features.title: Teacher-controlled
features.text: Classroom settings stay with your school.

pricing.title: Two plans. No surprises.
pricing.text: Start free. Upgrade when you want unlimited tutoring. Cancel anytime.

items.a: There is a free plan with core lessons. Paid plans add unlimited AI tutoring and offline mode.

items.q: Which devices does it work on?
items.a: Any modern browser on phones, tablets and computers.

items.q: Can teachers use it with a class?
items.a: Yes. Teachers can connect classes and follow progress with Google Classroom or Moodle.

items.q: Does the AI tutor see my private data?
items.a: Only what you choose to share in a conversation. We never sell your data.
